title: LLM-as-a-Supervisor: Mistaken Therapeutic Behaviors Trigger Targeted Supervisory Feedback
measurement_description: The paper does not specifically measure or evaluate aspects of religion or faith. Religion is only briefly mentioned as a demographic factor (alongside cultural background, gender, and sexual orientation) within the 'Ignore Cultural Background and Diversity' mistake category in their therapist training framework.
findings: The paper contains no findings related to religion. Religion is merely listed as an example of a client's cultural background that novice therapists must learn not to ignore during simulated sessions.
